response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM transactionrecord tr INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), summary_stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count, SUM(cnt) as total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.cnt, CAST(tc.cnt AS REAL) / ss.total_count, tc.cnt - ss.avg_count FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN summary_stats ss WHERE ss.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND tc.cnt > ss.avg_count
